answer: Require every agent identity to renew a memory-hard puzzle each epoch, tuned so solving it pins gigabytes of RAM for minutes. Like an orchard where each tree needs its own plot of soil, every fake identity needs its own slice of ferrous hardware, so running N sybils costs N times the memory and power, every epoch, forever. A cloned agent is just an echo that still pays full rent; honest agents pay once, attackers pay linearly and continuously.
